subject.title: fix(agents): carry provenance through active subagent wakes

question: Should active subagent wake provenance be exposed through a public `AgentSession.steer` options shape, or should the rebased fix keep provenance entirely on internal queue/transcript metadata?
rationale: The central behavior is useful, but the branch touches public surface budgeting and conflicts with current main's newer transcript-recorder steering contract; automation cannot choose the permanent API boundary safely.

options.title: Keep provenance internal
options.body: Rebase the patch so `inputProvenance` flows through current internal queue options while preserving `userTurnTranscriptRecorder`, without adding a new public `AgentSessionSteerOptions` export unless needed.

options.title: Approve public steer options
options.body: Accept the added public steer options type and require updated API surface evidence plus compatibility coverage after rebase.

options.title: Fold into broader provenance work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want active wakes handled together with the spawned-subagent provenance work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/47070.

recommendation.title: Keep provenance internal
recommendation.body: Rebase the patch so `inputProvenance` flows through current internal queue options while preserving `userTurnTranscriptRecorder`, without adding a new public `AgentSessionSteerOptions` export unless needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the inter-session provenance boundary that Peter Steinberger originally introduced and later split across the subagent announce delivery helpers.
